Zlib is an independent, unofficial client. It is not affiliated with or authorized by Z-Library. You need your own account and an accessible domain.

Follow local laws, copyright rules and the service provider's terms. Access and download only content you are entitled to use. Books, accounts, quotas and cloud records come from Z-Library; their completeness and availability are not guaranteed.

The app saves files to your selected folder and uses external apps to open or share them. Deleting a local file requires confirmation. You are responsible for keeping your files and account secure.

The software is provided as is under the MIT License, without warranties. Read the complete terms in Open source licenses.

We use no advertising, telemetry, usage analytics or automatic crash reporting, and run no personal-data collection service.

Your email and password are sent only to the selected Z-Library domain during login. Passwords are never stored. Cookies and session credentials are encrypted locally with Android Keystore. Add only custom domains you trust.

Search queries, book references and download requests go to your selected domain. Files and covers may come from other server-provided addresses. Cross-host requests do not carry your account Cookies or keys. These services have their own data practices.

Download tasks, file associations and settings remain on your device. Files are written only to the folder you authorize. Signing out removes that account's stored session, not downloaded files. App data is excluded from system backups and transfers.

Notification permission is used for download progress. Sharing opens only when you request it; you choose the recipient and content.

The app checks public GitHub Releases on startup and when requested, without book account information, Cookies or keys. GitHub processes connection information under its own policies. An APK is downloaded to your authorized folder only after you tap Update. After verification, Install opens the system installer for your confirmation. Installation permission is used only for this update flow. The author link opens GitHub. Updates are never downloaded or installed silently.

This policy may change with app releases. Uninstalling removes private app data. Files in your selected folder remain under your control.
